oracle_snapshots.name: Cult of Skaro
oracle_snapshots.text:
Whenever Cult of Skaro attacks, choose one at random —
• Thay — Put a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
• Caan — Draw two cards.
• Sec — Create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace.
• Jast — Each opponent loses 4 life.

strategy.primary: Attack-trigger artifact army: protect Cult of Skaro and attack every turn for a random but always useful mode (counters on artifact creatures, two cards, a 3/3 Dalek, or 4 life from each opponent); multiply attacks and triggers with Helm of the Host, extra combats and Strionic Resonator/Scientist Supreme.
strategy.secondary: Wide artifact-creature board scaled by Steel Overseer, Master of Etherium and The Cyber-Controller; Sword of Feast and Famine + Aggravated Assault infinite combats.

identity.why: Attack trigger with four random payoffs.
A hasty nonlegendary Cult every combat, each rolling its own trigger.
With Sword it is infinite combats; alone it is a repeatable extra attack.
Two-mana copier for Cult's artifact-source trigger.
Doctor Who artifact payoff that scales the counter mode.
